title: W3Schools: Membership Operator 'in'
description: Given an integer `item` and a list `collection`, return `True` if `item` is present in `collection`, else `False`.
starter_code:
def item_in_collection(item: int, collection: list[int]) -> bool:
    pass
solution:
def item_in_collection(item: int, collection: list[int]) -> bool:
    return item in collection
explanation: Evaluates Python 'in' containment in linear time.
